title: Injectivity of residue-supported modules with characteristic-zero derivation operators
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a socle-preserving embedding into a sum of injective hulls. Leibniz operators force divisibility by a parameter, and an induction on dimension then proves surjectivity on parameter torsion. This is a module classification from differential-operator structure with a complete divisibility argument.
